title: English Practice Quiz 0552
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: To confirm an instruction, you can say:
options: Could you please confirm the details?
questions.explanation: Could you please confirm... is polite and precise.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: ___ going to arrive soon.
questions.explanation: They're is the contraction of they are.

questions.question: Choose the passive form: 'The manager signed the letter.'
options: The letter was signed by the manager.
questions.explanation: Past simple passive: was/were + past participle.

questions.question: I have ___ friends in this city.
questions.explanation: A few is used with countable plural nouns.

questions.question: They finished ___ the room.
questions.explanation: Finish is followed by a gerund.

questions.question: You ___ wear your identity card at work.
questions.explanation: Modal verbs such as should are followed by the base verb without to.

questions.question: A person who repairs water pipes is a ___.
questions.explanation: A plumber installs and repairs water pipes and fittings.

questions.question: She is ___ university student.
questions.explanation: University begins with the consonant sound /y/, so use a.

questions.question: When I was five, I ___ swim.
You need a moment to think. You say:
options: Let me think for a moment.
questions.explanation: This phrase politely signals that you need a little time.
